utterances.speaker: Pia

utterances.speaker: Uli

utterances.speaker: Noah

utterances.speaker: Sam

utterances.speaker: Kira

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Noah — if you can double-check that, it’d be a big help. I’ll swing by a bit later and see what still needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, I’ll take another look and let you know if I spot anything I missed.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yep — Sunday at the community center now, and Rosa’s got the items and drop-off covered.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Leo — appreciate you spreading the word. See you Sunday at the community center!

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve got the tape and spare nails set aside, and I’ll check for the screwdriver too. Anything else you need for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great, thanks Uli — see you Sunday at the community center.

utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Bo — the repair drive is now Sunday at the community center. I’ll point out the first fix when you get there.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — Sunday at the community center works for me. Just point me to the first fix when I get there.

utterances.speaker: Sam
